reviewItem.question: Does "Ambient upgrade with DNS proxy: For upgrades to Istio 1.24.0 when using Ambient mode, with `cni.ambient.dnsCapture=true` configured, users will need to follow…" mean a change to migration:istio|name=ambient-dns-capture-upgrade-order (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: Upgrading to Istio 1.24.0 in ambient mode with cni.ambient.dnsCapture=true requires upgrading Istio CNI, restarting ambient-enrolled workloads, then upgrading Ztunnel, otherwise DNS resolution fails.
